en: Are you ready to go to the obstacle course?
The Brigands have attempted to nest themselves near the shoreline not far from here. Show us what you're made of, and clear them out.
Once the duel is engaged, you may duel with as many deaths as it takes. ^yellow;DODGE disabled and only MELEE damage works.^reset; ^orange;You cannot return once you leave.^reset;
There are directions to an office. ''Those interested in part-time detective work please visit.''
What we're doing is technically illegal, but they wouldn't mind, would they?
Yeah, still technically illegal...
There might be some of those gang folk here too. Bring a gun or something.
I need to get out of here...
Bring some firepower. We're going into a place that could very well be hostile.
This is it. The final push.
We just need to get past a few things, but we'll be out in no time, dear.
Enter Gazring Docking Bay 75?
For someone of your caliber, this shouldn't be too difficult for you.
It's here... somewhere. I'm certain. All the data, and of all I've known says it's here.
Conflict is always prevalent on Gazri. If you wish to fight for the sake of it, the option is there. Vehicles are provided for your use, of course.
Kamish trusts you enough, so I figured I should too. I've seen a little of what's up ahead, and it's a hellscape alright. Bring supplies. Maybe a few mates, too.
The Unitan Core Worlds are through here apparently. I've got a score to settle here, so it's just convenient that this is where we need to go anyways.
Head through to the mansion once more? We're here for treasure, and nothing more!
I rented an entire carrier with the funds from the Court Mage. It was a generous donation of... fumos. Kirisame loved 'em.
It's like some sort of Planetarium. The Unitans are here, and they're fighting some sort of eternal youkai war. I'll put in a good word for you if we meet them.
Ready to board the Lunarian transport?
Are you sure you're ready to enter the arena against the trio of Gladiators? Once inside the only escape is victory.
Are you sure you're ready to enter the arena against Volo the pet tamer? Once inside the only escape is victory.
Are you sure you're ready to enter the arena against the fire knight, Templar Inferno? Once inside the only escape is victory.

Are you ready for me to send you to Dreadwing so you can rough him up?
^red;You'll want to have good equipment for this.

Are you ready for me to send you to my ^orange;arms testing site^white; to fight my Shockhopper MK I?
^red;You'll want to have very good equipment for this.
Are you ready for me to deploy you to my ^orange;mech test course^white;? I built it in an abandoned freighter I stumbled upon.

Are you ready for me to send you to my ^orange;advanced mech test course^white;? 
^red;You might want to assemble a strong enough mech before you go.
